core_questions.question: Are you experiencing any double vision, slurred speech, weakness/numbness on one side of your face or body, or difficulty walking?
core_questions.safety_implication: Dizziness with focal neurological deficits strongly suggests acute posterior circulation stroke.

core_questions.question: Is the dizziness accompanied by chest pain, rapid fluttering heartbeat (palpitations), or shortness of breath?
core_questions.safety_implication: Dizziness with cardiac symptoms suggests arrhythmia or hemodynamic instability.

core_questions.question: Did you actually pass out / lose consciousness, or just feel lightheaded when standing up?
core_questions.safety_implication: Syncope (loss of consciousness) requires clinical evaluation to rule out cardiac/neurologic causes.

warning_signs.label: Dizziness with Slurred Speech or One-Sided Weakness

counterfactuals.condition: If accompanied by face drooping, speech slurring, or arm weakness
If true spinning sensation (vertigo) with vomiting or hearing changes
If brief lightheadedness upon standing up quickly that resolves in seconds
